missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Свидетель' stays in the nominative case as the masculine animate subject. 'Главный' is the agreeing masculine adjective.
Strategic focus: Accusative animate. 'Свидетеля' takes the accusative, which equals the genitive for animate masculine nouns. 'Важного' agrees in the animate accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Свидетеля' is the genitive form after 'у' to show whose memory it is. 'Этого' agrees in the masculine genitive.
Strategic focus: Dative object. 'Свидетелю' is the dative case required by the verb 'верить'. 'Этому' agrees in the masculine dative. A core dative-verb pattern.
Strategic focus: Instrumental predicate. 'Свидетелем' is the instrumental after 'стал' to mark the role he became. 'Главным' agrees in the masculine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О свидетеле' uses the prepositional form 'свидетеле' after 'об' to express talking about the witness. 'Этом' agrees in the masculine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Dative with preposition. 'Свидетелю' is the dative form after 'к' marking the person approached. A natural courtroom motion expression.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular after numeral. 'Свидетеля' takes the genitive singular after 'три', as numerals two through four require. A core numeral pattern.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Свидетели' is the nominative plural subject. 'Все' agrees in the plural, and 'рассказали' takes the plural verb ending.
Strategic focus: Accusative animate plural. 'Свидетелей' takes the accusative, which equals the genitive plural for animate nouns. 'Всех' agrees in the animate accusative plural.
